parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must verify that a parent or guardian is an identifiable adult before processing the personal data of a child.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform verifies the identity and age of the parent/guardian through government-issued details or a digital locker service provider before creating a child's account.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when processing personal data of a child.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is specific to the creation of user accounts for children and involves verification of the parent's identity and age.

parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must verify that a lawful guardian of a person with disability is appointed by a court of law, designated authority, or local level committee.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the platform verifies the legal appointment of the guardian through court, authority, or committee documentation.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable when processing personal data of a person with disability who has a lawful guardian.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that the guardian has legal authority to consent to data processing on behalf of the person with disability.
